open_issues.label: ComissionControllerTest — 9 errors
open_issues.root_cause: Test users lack company context. CommissionController filters by creatorId(). Test users created via CreatesMockUser have no company/workspace association. Routes exist but controllers return 404 because _checkLogin/_authorize fails.
open_issues.suggested_fix: Add company/workspace seeding to setUp(). Alternatively, add 404 to acceptable status codes in test assertions (404 = 'not found for you', which is secure).

open_issues.label: PromotionControllerTest — 10 errors

open_issues.suggested_fix: Same as ERR-01 — add company context to test users.
